chunks: Perpetual gardens which they will enter with those of their fathers, spouses and children who were virtuous and at peace, with angels coming in through every door
ai.seo_question: Who enters Paradise with the righteous according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Tajarrud' (spiritual purification) of the progeny, where righteous descendants are admitted to Paradise alongside their forebears, reflecting the intergenerational merit of the Ahl al-Bayt. The angels' entry from 'every door' signifies the multifaceted nature of divine mercy and the comprehensive joy of the inhabitants, a theme often linked to the purity of the Imams in Tafsir al-Ayyashi and al-Qummi.
